news.title: Quinn Hughes has a goal and an assist in his Vancouver return in Wild's 4-2 victory

news.description: — Former Vancouver captain Quinn Hughes had a goal to reach 500 NHL points and added an assist in his return to Rogers Arena in the Minnesota Wild’s 4-2 victory over the Canucks on Sunday night.

news.title: Ex-Canucks captain Quinn Hughes booed in Vancouver return with Wild
